limitations: Review used only the serialized JSON and original packet excerpts. No tools, external webpages or remembered target results were used; excerpt authenticity against external webpages cannot be attested.
Growth-bridge and some cash-flow excerpts omit headers; their column interpretations depend on packet metric labels and locators.
Market evidence, detailed exposures, insurance information, cash/debt breakdowns and actual diluted-share denominators are absent. Causal sensitivities and scenario probabilities cannot be verified.
Pass applies narrowly to internal historical mapping, contract compliance and transparently illustrative assumptions, not forecast accuracy.

findings.subject: Dates and seasonal baseline
findings.finding: All supplied publication dates precede the 2026-03-31 availability cutoff. FY2025 Q4 quarterly sales of USD 20,889 million correctly anchor target FY2026 Q4 sales; annual sales are not substituted. Missing FY2026 Q3 and target outcomes are disclosed.

findings.subject: Finance arithmetic, units and double counting
findings.finding: Mapped ratios and component totals agree with original packet amounts to stated rounding. Percent-to-decimal conversion, positive capex outflow, total-income cash conversion and attributable-income EPS treatment follow the contract. Historical growth contributions are not added again to scenario growth; other income is included once below modeled operating income.

findings.subject: Unresolved source inconsistencies
findings.finding: Original excerpts support the disclosed USD 1 million FY2025 Q3 reconciliation differences and FY2026 Q1 component total of 179 versus pretax-minus-operating of 178. Other-income labels vary. Contract placement is transparent, but neither the discrepancies nor external source classifications are resolved.

findings.subject: Scenario bounds and interpretation
findings.finding: All nine scenario rows respect contractual units and ranges. Adverse/favorable directions are coherent for the applicable earnings or cash-flow measure. Base values reference eligible seasonal and recent history; spreads are explicitly analyst judgments. Lower capex is appropriately limited to near-term cash flow, and share counts are not presented as observed repurchases.

findings.subject: Research causality and unsupported precision
findings.finding: Empty evidence appropriately produces no research signals or claimed market sensitivities. Rounded ratios and inferred shares are disclosed as approximations; scenario values are assumptions rather than precise observations. No insurance-specific claims or invented cash/debt facts appear.

findings.subject: Quotation fidelity
findings.finding: Several finance fields labeled source_excerpt concatenate or truncate original rows. Their numerical content is supported by the original packet, but those assembled strings are not single verbatim excerpts.
